name: Send to Mac/Android
tagline: Move files between your Mac and Android phone.
description: Send To Android runs on the Mac and Send to Mac runs on the phone. Drop files on one side and they arrive on the other, over Wi-Fi or a USB cable.

platforms.note: Send To Android. Not notarized, so allow the first launch in System Settings, Privacy & Security.

features.title: Wi-Fi or USB
features.text: Use the same network, or plug in a cable.

features.title: Pair with a QR code
features.text: Scan the code on your Mac to connect.

features.title: Works without the phone app
features.text: The phone's browser can open the transfer page instead.

features.title: Drag and drop
features.text: Drop files on the Mac window, or use Send to Mac from Android's share sheet.

setup: Open Send To Android on the Mac.
Install Send to Mac on the phone, or skip it and use the phone's browser.
Join the same Wi-Fi, then scan the QR code shown on the Mac.
Drop files to send. Files from the phone land in Downloads, in the Send To Android folder.
limits: Over Wi-Fi, files travel on your local network without extra encryption, so use a network you trust.
USB needs USB debugging and adb on the Mac.
